object_description: polygonal volume organically embedded at the site’s southern tip
design_condition: The polygonal volume is placed at the southern tip and sensitively embedded in the terrain, preserving the tree landscape and creating a communal play garden with differentiated outdoor areas between the day care and kindergarten.

positive.statement: The placement creates generous outdoor spaces and visual connections throughout the complex.
Almost the entire tree population can be preserved while the green structures continue to flow through the area.
The building is sensitively embedded in the given topography.
The large communal play garden uses the valuable trees as zoning and defining elements.
The outdoor spaces are accessible without barriers from inside and outside.
The arrangement of the split level as the main access staircase with lift is logical given the terrain.
The operational organization is convincing and provides enough space.
The two-story care units create different qualities of stay and a child-friendly atmosphere.
The structural system and simple ventilated facade construction appear logical.
All rooms receive plenty of daylight through the vertically arranged windows.

negative.statement: The new building comes too close to the oriental spruce, making its preservation questionable.
More paved area would be desirable for ball games and similar activities.
The outdoor equipment room, transshipment area, and bicycle and kickboard racks are not yet solved.
The facade toward Gessnerstrasse creates an inappropriate spatial narrowing.
The basement is completely missing from the depiction.
The split-level arrangement makes the building difficult to understand.
The facade has a schematic expression, especially through the almost flush windows.
The security aspect of the deep parapets has not yet been resolved.
Some facades do not correspond to the floor plans and vice versa.
The concept-dependent geometry minimizes subsequent flexibility of use.
The geometry creates excessive building volume through one-and-a-half-story rooms.
